articles.summary: Firefly successfully launched its Alpha rocket and deployed the VICTUS NOX payload following a 24-hour notice to complete final mission operations.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Successfully Launches U.S. Space Force VICTUS NOX Responsive Space Mission with 24-Hour Notice

articles.summary: Beginning in 2026, Firefly’s Alpha vehicle will provide three dedicated launches in support of L3Harris’ Space Business.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Awarded Multi-Launch Agreement with L3Harris

articles.summary: Firefly awarded third NASA CLPS contract to provide radio frequency calibration services from lunar orbit as part of Blue Ghost Mission 2.
articles.title: Firefly Awarded $18 Million NASA Contract to Provide Radio Frequency Calibration Services from Lunar Orbit
